import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long LIMIT = 100002;
    static final long INFINITY_VAL = 1000000007;
    static final double TOL = 1e-15;

    static long x_in, y_in, max_b;
    static double min_diff = INFINITY_VAL;
    static Pair best;

    static class Pair {
        long b, a;
        Pair(long b, long a) {
            this.b = b;
            this.a = a;
        }
    }

    static void update_if_better(long b, long a) {
        double diff = Math.abs((double)a / b - (double)x_in / y_in);
        if (diff + TOL < min_diff) {
            min_diff = diff;
            best = new Pair(b, a);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        x_in = sc.nextLong();
        y_in = sc.nextLong();
        max_b = sc.nextLong();

        for (long b = 1; b <= max_b; b++) {
            long a_floor = (x_in * b) / y_in;
            long a_ceil = a_floor + 1;
            update_if_better(b, a_floor);
            update_if_better(b, a_ceil);
        }
        System.out.println(best.a + "/" + best.b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
